status: Provisional retrospective competition predictor; independent confirmation required

findings.statement: Reference MAE is6.438128percentage points versus persistence7.373589. T73 improves5.278519 versus7.158378, while D245 slightly worsens7.597738 versus7.588800. The fitted early-rate coefficient is negative, challenging literal continuation of early competitive advantage. Neither nitrogen limitation nor a selection-reversal mechanism is identified. Schema exposure and two groups prevent a fresh discovery-admission claim.
findings.scope: Two reserved yeast strain labels, eighteen later author-derived qPCR percentages, same experiment campaign with audit-exposed targets; no blind validation or nutrient mechanism identification.

findings.statement: Group counterexamples, stronger-comparator outcomes and source ambiguities constrain mechanistic and industrial transfer claims; no equations are promoted solely because generated by a stronger model.

scientific_review: Computational checks by same operator in a separate phase; no independent agent, human expert or experimental replication.
